d: Search for a jailhouse apparition and visit a firehouse plagued by poltergeists.

st: Russell’s Story + Writing on the Wall
d: Meet a young man who’s revisited by a ghost he first met when he was five. Then witness sinister spirits torment a couple by throwing them and their furniture around the room.
Tackle a murderous force inside a prison cell and sniff out a killer shadow.
Investigate an EMT’s story of entwined souls and brave a soldier’s many ghosts.
Hear about a trooper’s and firefighter’s chilling encounters with the beyond.
A prisoner has trouble crossing over; a paramedic attracts a teenage ghost.
Meet an officer who hears voices and a paramedic who confronts a possessed teen.
Chase a home-invading ghost and witness a violent spirit attack on a paramedic.
Watch Marie’s dream house come alive with spirits when her husband and son leave her on her own. Then see what happens when a demonic energy takes over Louann’s house.

Join Amy and her mom in their new home, where they quickly get the sense that they’re not alone. Then see what happens after Jill returns from her grandfather’s funeral and hears the bathroom water running.

See what happens when Ron is snowed in at work and forced to stay overnight at a former insane asylum turned hospital. Meanwhile, 14-year-old Maria spots a strange silhouette that turns into something even more terrifying.
Come face to face with a dog demon and meet a mobster’s ghost in a jail cell.

st: Homeward Bound/Through The Looking Glass/Dearly Departing
d: Ride along as a spirit messes with a police car; meet a couple’s deceased son.

st: Fire Station Spirit/Don't Die at Christmas
d: Look into two hair-raising cases where EMTs encountered their patients’ souls.
Watch as a paramedic makes a dark connection; roam a school’s haunted halls.

Follow Justin and his friends to a psychiatric hospital known for ghostly activity. Then see what happens when Meghan’s family moves into a new house and she discovers a strange window beside her bedroom.

st: The Apartment + It Came From the Basement
d: Watch a young woman spend an unsettling evening in her very first apartment. Then see strange spirits chase a young man throughout his house, from his bedroom to the basement.
Witness a call from the beyond that helps save a baby; feel a spirit’s icy slap.
Meet families who are tormented by demons and aggressive ghosts after they move into their new homes.
